actual_scope: Preserve complete exact rational-rank certificates while accelerating sparse witness products and coefficient generation.
scope_change_reason: Explicit user request for less-obvious math-research process optimizations. Profile the current shared rank tool and its already optimized predecessor, rather than changing theorem premises.
bottleneck_link: Complete kernel witnesses contain free-coordinate identity blocks. Sparse exact dot products remove zero arithmetic, while denominator clearing removes repeated normalization in certificate generation.
stop_rule: Publish only after complete certificate equality, retained rejection predicates, and alternating fresh CLI produce/save/check measurements. No all-input, supplier-replay or kappa claim.
evidence: verify.py, PROOF.md and BENCHMARK.json; 596 complete certificate equalities, 70 product shapes, bounded fallback and corrupted-certificate controls.

ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in profiling, implementation, derivation, testing and packaging. No independent human or proof-kernel review.
